digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and route discovery
propositions: Pure-intercept routes lack visibility in overview help and fail under `rebar help <command>` because committed help artifacts do not exist
Identity child parsers reject `--help` because help actions are disabled and nested parser ownership is not established
Help discovery predicate must be `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across all four census sites to make registry-backed help authoritative
Generator normalization must unwrap argparse usage and normalize metavars for intercept routes without explicit usage while preserving explicit multiline `trusted-env` usage
Parser factory descriptions for `reconcile.build`, `enrich.build`, `identity.build`, and `certs.build_trusted_env` must be populated to enable route-owned summaries in overview help
Nested family coverage must distinguish parser-introspectable families from pure-intercept nested aliases and prove runtime membership matches generator census
